church.themeTitle: Moving In Obedience: Possessing Our Blessings
church.pastorQuote: We are excited that you are considering visiting Mission Church. We want to dispel any reservations you might have before you come by informing you as much as we can, so that you can come and worship Jesus.
church.welcomeBody: We all had a 'first day' at church—you'll find we are a friendly congregation. If you don't understand something, please simply ask. Come worship, grow, and serve with us in Somerville.

giving.scripture: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over... — Luke 6:38 (KJV)
giving.note: Offerings and tithes for Bishop Pastor Mitchell use the same church accounts—include a memo/designation (e.g. 'tithe', 'offering', or 'building fund'). For non-cash donations, contact Church Administrator Marshina Mitchell at missionchurch1@gmail.com or 617-863-6614.

faqs.q: Where Can I Find Mission Church?
faqs.a: 130 Highland Avenue, Somerville, MA 02143. The main Sunday worship service begins at 12:00 PM and normally includes singing, prayers, announcements, and testimonies. We suggest arriving at least 15 minutes early.
We have parking lots on both sides of the building and across the street. Our church deacons are happy to direct you to overflow parking, and we also use space graciously donated by our neighbors.

faqs.q: I Won't Know Anyone, Where Will I Sit?
faqs.a: As soon as you walk through the doors, someone will greet you and welcome you. Our friendly ushers and greeters will help with any special needs and help you find a comfortable seat. You can also connect with us ahead of time so someone meets you at the door.

You are welcome in whatever feels comfortable! Most of our congregation wears 'Sunday Best' (ties, jackets, and slacks for men; dresses and head coverings for women), but what matters most is that you feel at home.

faqs.q: What Do I Need To Bring?
faqs.a: A Bible will help you follow along in worship and Bible Study—we use the King James Version (KJV). Bishop Mitchell refers to Scripture often during his messages. If you don't have one or forget yours, ushers have Bibles available.
Yes! Bishop Malcolm D. Mitchell loves to meet guests and is available at the conclusion of any worship service to personally greet visitors.

faqs.q: I Have Physical Disabilities. Can You Accommodate Me?
faqs.a: Yes—we aim to be an all-inclusive church. Our building is wheelchair accessible with handicapped-accessible restrooms, elevators, and lifts. Contact the church office at 617-863-6614 for any specific arrangements.

Morning Prayer begins at 10:00 AM, followed by Sunday School (and Next Steps Class) at 10:30 AM. At 11:30 AM light refreshments are served in the Fellowship Hall. On the 1st Sunday we celebrate Communion; on other Sundays stay after 12 PM worship for Sunday dinner or refreshments.
